message: I have this friend who tends to panic at the slightest hint of trouble—like when the weather forecast shows a storm. Last week, she texted me in a frenzy about her go-bag, and it made me realize how important it is to have our plans in place, but also to stay calm. A little preparation can go a long way in keeping the worries at bay. What’s your go-to tip for staying grounded when things feel overwhelming?
